original_paragraph.Materials and Methods: Surface Plasmon Resonance (SPR). SPR biosensing experiments were performed on a Biacore S200 equipped with a Sensorchip SA at 25°C (GE Healthcare, Little Chalfont, UK) as described previously.¹ For immobilization, HBS-P+ (10 mM HEPES, 150 mM NaCl, 0.05% surfactant P20, pH 7.4; GE Healthcare) was used as the running buffer. The GDP- and GTP-bound forms of K-Ras were prepared by pretreatment with 1 mM GDP and GTP, respectively. For immobilization, each biotinylated K-Ras form was injected over the Sensorchip surface, yielding typical levels of approximately 5000 RUs. For the interaction study, HBS-P+ supplemented with 1% DMSO and 10 μM GDP or GTP was used as the running buffer. Serially diluted peptides were injected at a flow rate of 50 μL/min for 90 s, and subsequent dissociation was followed for up to 420 s. Data processing and analysis were performed using Biacore S200 evaluation software (GE Healthcare). Sensorgrams were double-referenced prior before global fitting of the concentration series to 1:1 binding with the mass transport model. The dissociation constant KD was calculated as follows: KD = koff/kon.

50800294.DESCRIPTION: Binding affinity to human N-terminal His/AVi-tagged biotinylated GTPase KRas G12D mutant (1 to 169 residues) expressed in Escherichia coli BL21 (DE3) in presence of GTP by SPR assay

original_paragraph.Materials and Methods: SPR measurements were performed using a Biacore T200 instrument (GE Healthcare). The human N-terminal His/AVi-tagged biotinylated GTPase KRas G12D mutant (1 to 169 residues) expressed in Escherichia coli BL21 (DE3) was immobilized on a streptavidin-coated sensor chip (SA sensor chip, GE Healthcare) via biotin-avidin interaction. The KRas G12D mutant was incubated with 10 mM DTT for 30 min to reduce the disulfide bond between Cys118 and Cys120, and then biotinylated with NHS-PEG4-biotin (Thermo Fisher Scientific) for 1 h at room temperature. The biotinylated KRas G12D mutant was immobilized on the SA sensor chip at a density of approximately 1000 RU. The SPR experiments were performed at 25 °C in HBS-EP buffer (10 mM HEPES, pH 7.4, 150 mM NaCl, 3 mM EDTA, 0.005% P20) at a flow rate of 30 μL/min. The KRas G12D mutant was pre-incubated with 100 μM GDP or 100 μM GTP for 10 min before injection. The KRas G12D mutant was then injected at a concentration of 100 nM for 120 s, followed by a dissociation phase for 300 s. The KRas G12D mutant was regenerated with 10 mM DTT for 30 s. The binding of KRpep-2d to the KRas G12D mutant was measured by injecting KRpep-2d at concentrations ranging from 0.1 to 100 nM for 120 s, followed by a dissociation phase for 300 s. The binding data were analyzed using the Biacore T200 evaluation software (GE Healthcare) with a 1:1 Langmuir binding model. The kinetic parameters were determined by global fitting of the data from multiple concentrations. The binding affinity (KD) was calculated as the ratio of the dissociation rate constant (koff) to the association rate constant (kon). The half-life (t1/2) was calculated as ln(2)/koff. The SPR experiments were performed in triplicate, and the data are presented as the mean ± standard deviation.

51146453.DESCRIPTION: Binding affinity to human wild type N-terminal His/AVi-tagged biotinylated KRas expressed in Escherichia coli BL21 (DE3) in presence of GDP by SPR assay
51146453.references_previous: Sakamoto, K.; Kamada, Y.; Sameshima, T.; Yaguchi, M.; Niida, A.; Sasaki, S.; Miwa, M.; Ohkubo, S.; Sakamoto, J.; Kamaura, M.; Cho, N.; Tani, A. K-Ras(G12D)-selective inhibitory peptides generated by random peptide T7 phage display technology. Biochem. Biophys. Res. Commun. 2017, 484, 605–611.

original_paragraph.Materials and Methods: SPR measurements were performed using a Biacore T200 instrument (GE Healthcare). The human wild-type N-terminal His/AVi-tagged biotinylated KRas protein was immobilized on a streptavidin-coated sensor chip (SA sensor chip, GE Healthcare) at a density of approximately 1000 response units (RU). The KRas protein was expressed in Escherichia coli BL21 (DE3) and purified as described previously.17 The SPR assay was performed in HBS-EP buffer (10 mM HEPES, pH 7.4, 150 mM NaCl, 3 mM EDTA, 0.005% P20) at 25 °C. KRpep-2d was diluted in the running buffer to concentrations ranging from 0.1 to 100 nM. The association phase lasted for 120 s, followed by a dissociation phase of 300 s. The sensor surface was regenerated with 10 mM glycine-HCl (pH 2.0) for 30 s. Data were analyzed using Biacore T200 evaluation software. The binding kinetics were determined by fitting the sensorgrams to a 1:1 Langmuir binding model. The dissociation half-life (t1/2) was calculated from the koff value using the equation t1/2 = ln(2)/koff. The KD values were calculated from the kon and koff values using the equation KD = koff/kon. The SPR binding assay was performed in triplicate, and the data are presented as the mean ± standard deviation.
original_paragraph.Table 1: The kinetic parameters of KRpep-2d binding to K-Ras(G12D), K-Ras(G12C), and WT K-Ras in the presence of GDP are shown in Table 1. The KD values for K-Ras(G12D), K-Ras(G12C), and WT K-Ras were 8.9 nM, 35 nM, and 58 nM, respectively. The kon values were 1.3 × 10^6 M^-1s^-1, 1.0 × 10^6 M^-1s^-1, and 1.6 × 10^6 M^-1s^-1, respectively. The koff values were 1.1 × 10^-2 s^-1, 3.5 × 10^-2 s^-1, and 9.3 × 10^-2 s^-1, respectively. The dissociation half-lives (t1/2) were 61 s, 20 s, and 7.5 s, respectively.
original_paragraph.Figure 2 caption: Figure 2. Binding interaction of KRpep-2d with K-Ras(G12D). The color scheme is as described for Figure 1. Orange dashed lines indicate hydrogen bonds. Arginine residues at both termini of the peptide were excluded for clarity.
original_paragraph.Supporting Information S1: The SPR sensorgrams for the binding of KRpep-2d to K-Ras(G12D), K-Ras(G12C), and WT K-Ras in the presence of GDP are shown in Figure S1. The sensorgrams show the association and dissociation phases of the binding reaction. The binding curves were fitted to a 1:1 Langmuir binding model to determine the kinetic parameters. The KD values were calculated from the kon and koff values. The dissociation half-lives were calculated from the koff values. The SPR binding assay was performed in triplicate, and the data are presented as the mean ± standard deviation.
